name: NetworkX
description: Open-source Python library for the creation, manipulation, and study of the structure, dynamics, and functions of complex networks. NetworkX provides data structures for graphs and digraphs, a comprehensive set of graph algorithms, and tools for network analysis including centrality, community detection, and path finding.
reputation: The standard Python library for network analysis; widely used in academia and industry with thousands of citations and millions of downloads.
notes: Pure analysis library; not a benchmark. Performance limited on very large graphs (millions of nodes) where igraph or graph-tool are preferred.
